title: 工作习惯追踪与业绩关联 - 2026 Q1
content:
# 工作习惯追踪与业绩关联 - 2026 Q1

## 目标
通过量化工作习惯执行情况，分析与业务成果的关联性，找到高杠杆习惯和需要改进的执行缺口。

## 追踪习惯

### 1. Code review before merge
- **目标**: 每日至少 review 1 个 PR
- **假设**: 提升代码质量 → 减少线上故障 → 客户满意度提升
- **Q1 数据**:
  - 1 月完成率: 68% (21/31)
  - 2 月完成率: 75% (21/28)
  - 3 月完成率 (截至 3/16): 81% (13/16)
  - **趋势**: 逐月改善

### 2. Weekly customer follow-up call
- **目标**: 每周至少 2 次客户沟通
- **假设**: 主动沟通 → 及时发现问题 → 提升续约率和 upsell 机会
- **Q1 数据**:
  - 1 月完成率: 50% (4/8 次)
  - 2 月完成率: 62% (5/8 次)
  - 3 月完成率 (截至 3/16): 75% (6/8 次)
  - **趋势**: 显著改善

### 3. Document system changes
- **目标**: 每日记录系统变更和故障处理
- **假设**: 知识沉淀 → 减少重复问题处理时间 → 提升团队效率
- **Q1 数据**:
  - 1 月完成率: 45% (14/31)
  - 2 月完成率: 52% (14/27) 
  - 3 月完成率 (截至 3/16): 57% (9/16)
  - **趋势**: 缓慢改善但仍不足

### 4. Exercise 30min
- **目标**: 每日运动 30 分钟
- **假设**: 身体健康 → 精力充沛 → 决策质量和工作效率提升
- **Q1 数据**:
  - 1 月完成率: 23% (7/31)
  - 2 月完成率: 18% (5/28)
  - 3 月完成率 (截至 3/16): 14% (2/16)
  - **趋势**: 持续恶化，需要警惕

## 业务成果追踪

### Q1 收入数据
- **1 月**: $42,500 (3 个付费客户)
- **2 月**: $44,200 (新增 1 个客户)
- **3 月** (截至 3/16): $15,500 (按月度预计 ~$29,000)

### 客户状态
- Active 客户: 4 个
- Trial 客户: 1 个 (创新软件，3/31 到期)
- Churn: 0 (Q1 无流失)
- Upsell 机会: 数据云科技 (Standard → Premium)

## 关联分析

### 强相关发现
1. **客户沟通习惯 ↔ 客户满意度/续约**
   - 2 月客户沟通频率提升后，3 月无 churn
   - 每次沟通都产生了具体价值（问题解决、需求收集、关系维护）
   - **结论**: 这是最高 ROI 的习惯，必须保持

2. **Code review 习惯 ↔ 系统稳定性**
   - 1 月 code review 率低（68%），当月发生 2 次线上故障
   - 3 月 code review 率提升（81%），截至目前仅 1 次小故障
   - **结论**: 间接但重要，支撑服务质量

### 需要改进
1. **文档习惯完成率低**
   - 当前 57%，导致知识流失
   - 3/12 故障复盘因缺少实时记录，事后重建花费 2 小时
   - **行动**: 设置强制提醒，处理完问题立即记录

2. **个人健康习惯严重不足**
   - 14% 完成率，长期会影响精力和判断力
   - 2 月底有一次因熬夜导致的决策失误（推送了未充分测试的代码）
   - **行动**: 早起运动，不能再拖

3. **Trial 客户转化被拖延**
   - 创新软件 3/8 后未跟进，可能错失转化
   - **行动**: 本周一优先处理

## 下阶段目标 (3/17 - 3/31)

1. 客户沟通习惯保持 100%
2. 文档习惯提升到 80%+
3. 运动习惯提升到 50%+
4. 完成创新软件转化
5. 推进数据云科技 upsell

---

title: Production Incident - Server Disk Failure 2026-03-15
content:
# Production Server Disk Failure - 2026-03-15

## Incident Summary
- **Time**: 2026-03-15 13:45 CST
- **Severity**: P1 - Production API degraded
- **Impact**: API error rate spiked to 15%, database connection pool exhausted
- **Root Cause**: NVMe SSD failure on primary database server (Dell PowerEdge R740)

## Timeline
- 13:45 - Alert received: disk I/O errors
- 13:50 - Confirmed disk failure via CLI diagnostics
- 14:00 - Failover to standby server initiated
- 14:15 - Service restored, error rate back to normal
- 14:20 - Started procurement process for replacement disk

## Hardware Replacement Decision
- **Required**: Enterprise NVMe SSD 2TB (SKU-2080)
- **Vendor**: TechSource Hardware Solutions
- **Options**:
  1. Online order: 3-day standard delivery, next-day +500 CNY
  2. Office pickup: 3km away (Zhangjiang), 30min round trip

## CLI Inventory Check Results (14:30)
- Online stock: 0 units (out of stock)
- Office location stock: 2 units available
- Office hours: Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00, Sat 10:00-16:00
- Current time: Saturday 14:30 - **office is open**

## Decision
Given urgency (P1 incident, standby server is single point of failure) and office availability, **immediate office pickup recommended** over waiting for online restock.

## Next Steps
- [ ] Navigate to vendor office via Maps
- [ ] Purchase replacement disk
- [ ] Install and validate
- [ ] Update CTO on ETA
- [ ] Document in incident log

title: CloudInfra Maintenance 2026-02 - Runbook
content:
# CloudInfra Maintenance Runbook - Feb 1-2, 2026

Created: 2026-01-26
Owner: Lin Zhenkai
Status: Draft

## Overview

**Maintenance Window:**
- Start: Feb 1, 2026, 10:00 CST
- End: Feb 2, 2026, 14:00 CST
- Duration: ~28 hours

**Affected CloudInfra Services:**
- Block Storage API (5-10s delay expected)
- Load Balancer Control Plane (5-10s delay expected)

**SLA Changes (Effective Feb 15):**
- Block Storage: 99.95% → 99.9%
- Load Balancer: 99.99% → 99.95%

## Impact Assessment

### Critical Services Affected

1. **Primary API Service** (HIGH)
   - Dependency: Block Storage API (data reads)
   - Current timeout: 10s
   - Risk: Timeout errors if API delay reaches 10s
   - Mitigation: Increase timeout to 15s, add retry logic

2. **Customer Data Export Job** (MEDIUM)
   - Dependency: Block Storage + Load Balancer API
   - Schedule: Daily 03:00 CST (falls within window on Feb 2)
   - Risk: Job failure on Feb 2
   - Mitigation: Disable Feb 2 job, run manual export on Feb 3

3. **Background Worker Pool** (LOW)
   - No direct dependency on affected services
   - No action required

### Blast Radius
- Estimated affected API calls: ~30% during maintenance window
- Customer impact: Potential 5-10s response time increase
- Premium tier SLA: Within acceptable range (P95 < 2s → may breach temporarily)

## Pre-Maintenance Checklist

- [ ] Jan 28: Update API timeout config to 15s in staging
- [ ] Jan 28: Test retry logic in staging (exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s)
- [ ] Jan 29 10:00: Deploy timeout + retry changes to production
- [ ] Jan 29 12:00: Monitor production for 2 hours post-deployment
- [ ] Jan 30: Prepare rollback script (revert timeout to 10s)
- [ ] Jan 31 17:00: Send email to Premium tier customers (template in [[Customer-Comms]])
- [ ] Jan 31 18:00: Disable Feb 2 export job in scheduler (JOB-702)
- [ ] Jan 31 23:00: Enable enhanced monitoring (1-min intervals)

## During Maintenance

### Monitoring Checkpoints

**Feb 1, 10:00 - 12:00 (First 2 hours):**
- Check error rate dashboard every 15 min
- Verify retry logic is triggering (check application logs)
- Alert threshold: error rate > 5%

**Feb 1, 12:00 - Feb 2, 06:00:**
- Check dashboard every 2 hours
- Alert threshold: error rate > 10%

**Feb 2, 06:00 - 14:00 (Final 8 hours):**
- Check dashboard every 30 min
- Prepare for post-maintenance verification

### Degradation Procedure

If error rate exceeds 15% for >10 minutes:

1. Enable read-only mode (disable write APIs)
2. Notify CTO via WeChat
3. Post status update to customer dashboard
4. Prepare incident report template

## Rollback Procedures

### Scenario 1: Timeout config causes issues
1. Run rollback script: `./scripts/revert-timeout-config.sh`
2. Verify config in production: `curl https://api.lingxi-ai.com/health`
3. Monitor for 30 min

### Scenario 2: Retry logic causes cascading failures
1. Deploy hotfix to disable retry: `git revert abc123 && ./deploy.sh`
2. Restart API instances (rolling restart, 1 at a time)
3. Monitor for 1 hour

## Post-Maintenance Verification

**Feb 3, 10:00 - 12:00:**

- [ ] Verify Block Storage API latency back to baseline (<100ms P95)
- [ ] Verify Load Balancer API latency back to baseline (<50ms P95)
- [ ] Check error rate dashboard (should be <0.5%)
- [ ] Run manual data export job for Feb 2 missed run
- [ ] Verify export job completes successfully
- [ ] Re-enable automated export job (JOB-702)
- [ ] Disable enhanced monitoring (revert to 5-min intervals)
- [ ] Send follow-up email to Premium customers (all clear)
- [ ] Create post-mortem note in [[Incidents/2026-Q1]]

## SLA Change Impact (Feb 15 onwards)

### New SLA Math
- Block Storage 99.9% = ~43 min downtime/month (was ~21 min)
- Load Balancer 99.95% = ~21 min downtime/month (was ~4 min)

### Action Items
- [ ] Update monitoring alert thresholds (account for new SLA)
- [ ] Review customer-facing SLA commitments (do we need to adjust?)
- [ ] Discuss multi-cloud failover strategy with CTO (future work)

## Related Documents

- Architecture: [[OBSN-5]] (CloudInfra Dependencies)
- Incident History: [[OBSN-2]] (Past production incidents)
- Vendor Contact: [[OBSN-4]] (TechSource - different vendor, reference only)

## Communication Log

- 2026-01-24 09:15: Received vendor notification email (WMSG-5007)
- 2026-01-26 18:45: Sent impact assessment to CTO (WMSG-5009)
- 2026-01-27: (Pending) CTO approval to proceed

---

**Next Review:** 2026-02-03 (post-maintenance)

- **Dependency:** Video transcoding cache and HLS segment delivery
- **Traffic:** ~500k requests/day
- **Criticality:** HIGH - Premium feature
- **Fallback:** None configured
- **Notes:** Uses WebSocket for real-time progress updates

### 4. AI Model Assets (models.lingxi-ai.com)
- **Dependency:** Model weight file CDN caching
- **Traffic:** ~50k requests/day
- **Criticality:** Medium - impacts model loading time
- **Fallback:** Direct GCS bucket access

   - Customer-facing impact: HIGH
   - Expected error rate: 2-5% during edge rotation
   - Estimated affected users: ~500-1000 concurrent users
   - Revenue impact: Potential Premium tier SLA breach

2. **Media Streaming Service** (media.lingxi-ai.com)
   - Customer-facing impact: HIGH
   - WebSocket disconnections expected
   - Premium feature - direct customer complaints likely

3. **API Documentation Portal** (api.lingxi-ai.com/docs)
   - Customer-facing impact: LOW
   - Acceptable degradation

### Pre-Maintenance Actions

#### T-72h (Feb 12, 10:00)

- [ ] Verify Cloudflare secondary CDN credentials

#### T-48h (Feb 13, 10:00)

  - Nginx upstream timeout: 30s → 60s
  - Application connection timeout: 10s → 20s
  - Test with simulated CDN latency

#### T-24h (Feb 14, 10:00)

- [ ] Verify monitoring alerts are active
- [ ] Confirm on-call rotation (Lin Zhenkai primary, Wang Ming backup)

#### T-2h (Feb 15, 08:00)

- [ ] Verify origin server capacity headroom (>40% CPU/memory available)
- [ ] Pre-position rollback scripts in `/opt/maintenance/rollback-cdn-config.sh`

- [ ] Monitor origin server load: CPU < 80%, memory < 85%

```bash
cd /opt/maintenance
./rollback-cdn-config.sh
sudo systemctl reload nginx

```

### Post-Maintenance Actions

#### T+2h (Feb 16, 16:00)
- [ ] Verify cache hit ratio returned to baseline (>85%)
- [ ] Check error rate returned to normal (<0.1%)
- [ ] Run smoke tests on all CDN-dependent services
- [ ] Revert timeout configurations if no issues observed

#### T+24h (Feb 17, 14:00)
- [ ] Generate incident report (even if no issues)
- [ ] Update this runbook with lessons learned
- [ ] Send maintenance completion notice to Premium customers

title: Production Architecture - Database Dependencies Map
content:
# Database Dependencies Map

## CloudInfra PostgreSQL Cluster (AP-East-1)

**Cluster ID:** `pg-prod-ap-east-1-primary`
**Endpoint:** `pg-prod.ap-east-1.cloudinfra.io:5432`

### Dependent Services

#### 1. API Gateway Service
- **Service:** `api-gateway-prod`
- **Dependency Type:** Primary data store
- **Tables Used:** `users`, `api_keys`, `rate_limits`, `audit_logs`
- **Connection Pool:** 50 connections (max_connections: 200)
- **Retry Logic:** 3 retries with exponential backoff (500ms, 2s, 5s)
- **Fallback:** Read-only mode using cached data (15min TTL)

#### 2. Analytics Pipeline
- **Service:** `analytics-worker-prod`
- **Dependency Type:** Event storage
- **Tables Used:** `events`, `metrics`, `aggregations`
- **Connection Pool:** 20 connections
- **Retry Logic:** Queue-based retry (SQS buffer)
- **Fallback:** Write to S3 backup, replay on recovery

#### 3. User Management Service
- **Service:** `user-mgmt-prod`
- **Dependency Type:** Primary data store
- **Tables Used:** `user_profiles`, `sessions`, `permissions`
- **Connection Pool:** 30 connections
- **Retry Logic:** 5 retries with jitter
- **Fallback:** Degraded mode (read from replica)

### Health Check Endpoints

```bash
# API Gateway health
curl https://api.lingxi-ai.com/health/db

# Analytics pipeline status
curl http://analytics-internal:8080/health

# User management health
curl http://user-mgmt-internal:9090/health/database
```

- **2026-02-01:** CloudInfra timeout config deployment - [[CloudInfra Maintenance 2026-02 - Runbook]]
- **2026-02-15:** CDN maintenance - [[CloudInfra CDN Maintenance 2026-02-15 - Runbook]]

### Connection Pool Monitoring

**Grafana Dashboard:** `Production DB Connections`
**Alert Thresholds:**
- Warning: >80% pool utilization
- Critical: >95% pool utilization
- Error rate: >1% failed connections

# CloudInfra Database Maintenance Runbook

**Maintenance Window:** April 8-9, 2026 (02:00-06:00 UTC / 10:00-14:00 CST)
**Vendor:** CloudInfra Database Operations
**Affected Cluster:** `pg-prod-ap-east-1-primary`

## Pre-Maintenance Checklist

### T-48 Hours (April 6, 10:00 CST)

- [ ] Verify all dependent services have connection retry logic
  - API Gateway: ✓ (3 retries, exponential backoff)
  - Analytics Pipeline: ✓ (SQS buffer enabled)
  - User Management: ✓ (5 retries with jitter)
- [ ] Review current connection pool utilization (target: <60% baseline)
- [ ] Verify read replica lag is <5 seconds
- [ ] Test failover procedures in staging environment
- [ ] Notify Premium customers (CUS-102, CUS-104, CUS-105) of maintenance window
- [ ] Create incident channel in Mattermost: `#incident-db-maintenance-2026-04`

### T-24 Hours (April 7, 10:00 CST)

- [ ] Run health check regression suite (JOB-702)
- [ ] Verify backup completion (last successful: within 6 hours)
- [ ] Confirm on-call rotation coverage (Lin Zhenkai primary, Wang Ming secondary)
- [ ] Pre-stage rollback scripts in `/opt/runbooks/db-rollback/`
- [ ] Set Grafana annotation for maintenance window start

### T-2 Hours (April 8, 08:00 CST)

- [ ] Verify monitoring dashboards are accessible
- [ ] Confirm vendor support channel is active
- [ ] Enable verbose logging on API Gateway connection pool

## Monitoring Procedures

### During Maintenance Window

1. `Production DB Connections` - Monitor connection pool saturation
2. `API Gateway Error Rates` - Track 5xx responses

- Connection failures: >5% (normal: >1%)
- API error rate: >3% (normal: >0.5%)
- Response time P95: >2s (normal: >500ms)

**Monitoring Frequency:**
- Every 5 minutes: Check Grafana dashboards
- Every 15 minutes: Log status update in incident channel
- Continuous: Monitor vendor status page

**Key Metrics to Watch:**
```bash
# Connection pool utilization
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='lingxi_prod';

# Replication lag (if replica is available)
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()));

# Active queries
SELECT pid, query_start, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle';
```

## Rollback Criteria

**Immediate Rollback Triggers:**
1. Connection failure rate >10% for >5 minutes
2. API error rate >5% for >3 minutes
3. Data corruption detected in any table
4. Vendor declares maintenance failure

**Rollback Procedure:**
1. Contact vendor support immediately (db-support@cloudinfra-vendor.com)
2. Request immediate rollback to pre-maintenance snapshot
3. Notify CTO via Fossify Messages
4. Update incident channel with rollback status
5. Estimated rollback time: 30-45 minutes

**Rollback Decision Authority:**
- Primary: Lin Zhenkai
- Secondary: Wang Ming (CTO)

## Post-Verification Steps

### Immediate (Within 30 Minutes of Completion)

- [ ] Verify all services report healthy database connections
- [ ] Check connection pool metrics return to baseline
- [ ] Validate query performance (P95 latency <200ms)
- [ ] Confirm read replica sync lag <5 seconds
- [ ] Run smoke tests on critical API endpoints

### T+2 Hours

- [ ] Review error logs for any connection retry patterns
- [ ] Verify analytics pipeline queue has drained
- [ ] Check for any data inconsistencies in audit logs
- [ ] Confirm backup schedule resumed successfully

### T+24 Hours (April 9, 14:00 CST)

- [ ] Generate maintenance summary report
- [ ] Document any issues encountered
- [ ] Update architecture dependency map if needed
- [ ] Send completion notification to Premium customers
- [ ] Schedule post-mortem if any incidents occurred

## Communication Plan

### Customer Notifications

**T-48 Hours:** Email to Premium tier customers (CUS-102, CUS-104, CUS-105)
- Subject: "Scheduled Database Maintenance - April 8-9, 2026"
- Content: Maintenance window, expected impact, support contact

**T-0 (Maintenance Start):** Status page update
- Update: https://status.lingxi-ai.com
- Message: "Scheduled maintenance in progress"

**T+30 Minutes (Post-Completion):** Status page update

**Fossify Messages to CTO:**

- T-0: "DB maintenance started, monitoring active"
- T+30 Minutes: "DB maintenance completed, all services healthy"
- If issues: Immediate notification with impact assessment
